headline: Climatologist, Climate Researcher | R & Geospatial Instructor
statusBadge: Available for PhD Positions & Research Collaborations
bioParagraph1: My research focuses on climate modelling, Earth system models, and the analysis of large-scale climate datasets, with particular interest in model uncertainty, systematic biases, climate forcings, and climate extremes. In my MSc thesis, I compared CMIP5 and CMIP6 models to evaluate their performance in simulating temperature over Iran and investigated the effects of greenhouse-gas and natural forcings using DAMIP experiments.
bioParagraph2: I have experience working with Python and R for climate data analysis, statistical modelling, spatial analysis, and reproducible workflows. I am currently expanding my research skills in machine learning and deep learning, with a focus on regression, classification, neural networks, and data-driven methods.
bioParagraph3: My current research interest is to combine my background in climate science and Earth observation with machine learning for environmental and climate applications and climate extremes detection.
